title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - System Will Not Power On or Complete Startup
description: TRS components that do not power on, initialize normally, or become ready for use due to battery, connection, control, or external equipment problems.

ccr.complaint: Operating room staff reported that the DePuy Synthes TRS handpiece would not power on when prepared for a procedure.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found that the installed power source was not providing normal operation and the handpiece powered correctly with a known-good compatible power source.
ccr.resolution: Replaced the suspect power source with a verified compatible unit, confirmed repeated startup and functional operation, and returned the handpiece to service.

helpfulDetails: Signs of moisture, contamination, damage, or heat
Whether the problem followed the handpiece or power source

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Battery Will Not Charge or Runtime Is Short
description: Power sources that do not charge normally, provide unexpectedly short runtime, or appear unreliable due to charging, contact, storage, or load-related conditions.

ccr.complaint: OR staff reported that a DePuy Synthes TRS power source showed inadequate runtime and the handpiece stopped during use.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering reproduced reduced operation with the suspect power source while the handpiece operated normally with a known-good compatible power source.
ccr.resolution: Removed the unreliable power source from service, verified normal TRS operation with a known-good power source, and returned the handpiece to service.

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Display, Touchscreen, or Controls Are Unresponsive
description: Unresponsive TRS operating controls or applicable interface components caused by power, mechanical obstruction, accessory, contamination, or external setup problems.

ccr.complaint: OR staff reported that the operating trigger on the DePuy Synthes TRS handpiece did not consistently respond.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found contamination around the accessible trigger area that restricted normal movement, with no visible damage to the handpiece.
ccr.resolution: Cleaned the accessible exterior according to approved handling practices, confirmed smooth and repeatable trigger response during functional testing, and returned the unit to service.

helpfulDetails: Whether the issue can be reproduced

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Accessory or Module Is Not Recognized
description: TRS attachments, accessories, power components, or modular components that do not engage, operate, or interact correctly with the surgical power system.

ccr.complaint: OR staff reported that a TRS attachment would not operate when installed on the surgical handpiece.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found that the attachment was not fully seated in the handpiece interface and the locking mechanism had not completely engaged.
ccr.resolution: Reinstalled the compatible attachment correctly, verified secure engagement and normal powered operation, and returned the system to service.

helpfulDetails: Whether the failure follows the accessory

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Self-Test or Calibration Will Not Complete
description: TRS equipment that cannot complete an applicable startup check, functional check, calibration, or verification because of setup, power, accessory, or service-level problems.

ccr.complaint: Clinical staff reported that the DePuy Synthes TRS system would not complete the required pre-use functional check.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found that an attachment was not fully seated, preventing normal operation during the check.
ccr.resolution: Correctly installed the compatible attachment, repeated the full functional check successfully, and returned the system to service.

helpfulDetails: Exact test or verification being performed
Point at which the test fails

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Output Is Low, Unstable, or Inaccurate
description: Weak, intermittent, inconsistent, or unexpected TRS powered performance caused by power-source, accessory, attachment, control, mechanical, or load-related problems.

ccr.complaint: OR staff reported that the DePuy Synthes TRS handpiece had weak and intermittent powered performance during setup.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found that the installed power source reproduced the weak output while the handpiece operated normally with a known-good compatible power source.
ccr.resolution: Removed the unreliable power source, verified stable TRS operation with a known-good replacement, and returned the handpiece to service.

helpfulDetails: Whether the device stops under load

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Alarm Persists or Audio Is Weak or Missing
description: Persistent warnings or applicable audible indications associated with TRS equipment, including conditions caused by power, accessories, setup, environment, or component failure.

ccr.complaint: OR staff reported a persistent warning indication from the DePuy Synthes TRS equipment during setup.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found that an external component was not fully seated and the warning cleared when the component was correctly installed.
ccr.resolution: Reseated the compatible component, confirmed the warning remained cleared during repeated functional checks, and returned the equipment to service.

helpfulDetails: Whether audio is absent, weak, distorted, or intermittent

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Network, Data Export, or Interface Communication Failure
description: Communication problems involving any supported TRS external interface, connected accessory, charger, service interface, or data function present in the installed configuration.

ccr.complaint: Staff reported that a supported TRS-related external interface was not communicating with the connected service equipment.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found a loose external interface connection and confirmed that the primary TRS equipment itself was functioning normally.
ccr.resolution: Reseated the connection, verified stable communication and normal device operation, and returned the applicable equipment to service.

helpfulDetails: External system or service equipment involved
Whether another device works on the same connection
Whether primary TRS operation is affected

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Unexpected Shutdown, Freeze, or Restart
description: TRS equipment that stops unexpectedly, becomes nonresponsive, intermittently loses operation, or restarts because of power, accessory, load, control, or internal problems.

ccr.complaint: OR staff reported that the DePuy Synthes TRS handpiece stopped unexpectedly during powered operation.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found that the shutdown followed the installed power source and did not occur with a known-good compatible power source.
ccr.resolution: Removed the unreliable power source, completed repeated operational testing with a verified replacement, and returned the handpiece to service.

helpfulDetails: Abnormal heat, odor, noise, or vibration

title: DePuy Synthes TRS Surgical Power System - Preventive Maintenance or Electrical Safety Test Failure
description: TRS equipment that fails an applicable PM, inspection, functional, performance, or electrical safety requirement during Clinical Engineering evaluation.

ccr.complaint: The DePuy Synthes TRS system failed functional inspection during scheduled preventive maintenance because powered operation was intermittent.
ccr.cause: Clinical Engineering found that the intermittent operation followed a degraded power source while the handpiece operated normally with a known-good compatible power source.
ccr.resolution: Removed the degraded power source from service, repeated the applicable functional PM checks successfully with a verified power source, and returned the handpiece to service.

helpfulDetails: Exact PM or safety test failed
